title: Discover shared-connection avatar summary
summary: Replace Explore people with a real shared-connection summary, or a More people to meet fallback containing additional eligible suggestions from the same bounded response.
dataSourcesChanged: Optional read of accepted connection edges and visible active peer identities; no writes or schema changes
concurrencyRisk: Compute distinct peers from live accepted edges for server-authorized suggestion ids. Hide summaries if their target set no longer matches the current suggestions. Preserve existing connection/privacy invalidation. Include the opt-in flag in server cache/in-flight and client query keys; share SSR data between the Discover parent and rail. No new background polling or per-card requests. Fetch seven suggestions once: three full cards plus four additional profiles. Restrict shared-connection totals to the three cards; never count the additional suggestions as mutuals.

rollback.strategy: Revert the shared summary presentation and optional read only, preserving all prior workspace edits and connection data.
validation: Suggestion lists and connection actions continue working
Other feeds skip the additional read
Empty/error summaries never show placeholder identities

commands: npx eslint <changed source and test files>
DATABASE_URL_FRESH=<disposable> npx tsx --test --test-name-pattern='Discover shared summary' tests/db/connections-paging.test.ts
npx playwright test -c tests/browser/playwright.config.ts rails.spec.ts --project=chromium --project=webkit --grep 'Discover shared|profile headings'
